summary.zh: 假光标沿弧线滑到按钮上，按下、按钮下沉，然后一枚印章从高处加速砸下来，落地那一下整张卡片跟着震。适合做产品演示。
summary.en: A fake cursor arcs to the button, presses it down, then a stamp slams in from above and the whole card jolts on impact. Great for product demos.

technique.zh: 全部用 element.animate() 串成 async 时间线。光标的中间关键帧偏上形成弧线；印章用 ease-in 曲线（越落越快）从 scale(2.6) rotate(-26deg) 到 scale(1) rotate(-12deg)，mix-blend-mode: multiply 像印泥。
technique.en: One async timeline of element.animate() calls. A raised middle keyframe gives the cursor its arc; the stamp falls with an ease-in curve from scale(2.6) rotate(-26deg) to scale(1) rotate(-12deg), multiply-blended like ink.

adapt.zh: 印章文字改 .stamp 里的两行；光标目标是 #btn，换成任何元素都行。
adapt.en: Change the two lines inside .stamp; the cursor targets #btn, point it at any element.
